_readme: Course notes for the profile. The elevation line itself comes from the GPX (gpx below) via scripts/training/build-training.mjs. Section ranges are in official race miles; the GPX distance is scaled to 31.4.

sections.name: Canyon descent
sections.practice: Controlled downhill after you are already 8 miles in
sections.rehearsed: Controlled descents on the Jan 9 trail 12 and the Feb 13 peak 20

sections.name: Quarry to ALT climb
sections.practice: Long moderate climb, two bottles, 7.5-mile aid gap
sections.rehearsed: Two-bottle 7–8 mi stretches on Jan 16, Jan 30, and Feb 13

sections.name: Goat Hill
sections.practice: Late hike-up on tired legs, no poles
sections.rehearsed: Short steep hills Jan 14 and Feb 4; the Feb 6 trail 18 ends with a hike-up

sections.name: Final climb
sections.practice: A second late climb, then 1.4 mi to the finish
sections.rehearsed: A late tired climb on the Feb 13 peak 20
